title: A bill to designate the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Bozeman, Montana, as the "Travis W. Atkins Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic".
official_summary: This bill designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Bozeman, Montana, as the Travis W. Atkins Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic or the Travis W. Atkins VA Clinic.

summary.headline: A 2020 law renames the VA clinic in Bozeman, Montana, after Travis W. Atkins.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Bozeman, Montana, the Travis W. Atkins Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic. The clinic may also be called the Travis W. Atkins VA Clinic. It changes only the clinic's name and does not change its services or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 30, 2020.
